target: tsan+dan chu yis dri zhim nor bu'i rdo la mdzes mas dus btab rtse dga' la chags pas/ / khyod kyis rig pa'i grub pa thob pas tsan+dan chu yis dri zhim nor bu'i rdo steng du/ / nor bu rin po che yi rdo/ / de la tsan+dan la sogs bskus/ / lha mo rnams kyang 'tshog sa byas/ /
